B13-11's results/b13_11/inherited_rules.json names the rules in prose; this gives each one a predicate over (n, r, delta) so a cell catalog can be joined against it. This file is the PROVED-index-to-catalog join; keeping them apart is what let batch 13 close the same cells twice.
